hidden_dimension: Reservation itinerary destination; do not rely on stale top-level header after backend flight replacement.
legal_handling: Decline requested destination-changing modification and transfer; keep original itinerary. Destination-preserving modification exists as a policy action class but no goal-equivalent alternative to this fixed destination request is claimed or mined. Cancellation/rebooking is not silently substituted.
